description: What is physically loaded on the deck right now. This is the per-run file - edit it, do not edit deck.json or labware.json.

placements.name: tubes
placements.mount_note: NOT slot-mounted. The grid spans X 78-186, Y 151-223, so its centre (132.0, 187.0) sits BETWEEN slot 8 (200, 178.5) and slot 9 (65, 178.5) - 68 mm from one and 67 mm from the other. It straddles the slot boundary and cannot be assigned to either. Treated as a fixed station with an explicit anchor.
placements.anchor_note: machine coords of well (row 0, col 0). Column index advances toward -X at 12.0 mm; row index advances toward -Y at 18.0 mm.
placements.near_slot_note: Operator refers to this as position 8. Recorded as a REFERENCE, not a seating claim: this is a bespoke non-SBS fixture whose grid centre (132.0, 187.0) lands 0.25 mm from the slot 8/9 cell seam, so it is seated in neither. Position comes from anchor_xy, not from the slot.

placements.name: tips

corners.note: Three measured WELL CENTRES, not the box outline - the 100 x 63.7 mm span is far smaller than an SBS footprint. The grid is solved from these so real pitch and any rack rotation fall out of the measurement.

solved.note: col_pitch = 100.0/11, row_pitch = 63.7/7. Assuming the nominal 9.00 would accumulate ~1.0 mm of X error by column 12 - enough to miss a tip. Solved centre X 68.0 vs slot 3 centre X 65.0 is a 3.0 mm slot offset, which is what confirmed the x' = 420 + x frame.

placements.stale_note: The old TIP_X, TIP_Y = 218, 309 station in examples/300ulaccuracyprecision.py points nowhere near this box (X 18-118, Y 335.5-399.2). It is stale and is not carried forward.
placements.slot_note: Operator states stage location 4. The measured corners put this rack's grid centre at (68.0, 367.35), which is 3.0 mm from slot 3 (65.0, 365.0) and 284 mm from slot 4 (336.0, 272.0) under the x'=420+x frame. Two independent arguments say 4 is unreachable rather than merely offset: (a) this rack's Y puts it in the TOP row, and slots 4-6 are the middle row - exactly one 93 mm row pitch out; (b) the rack sits at a grid CORNER, and across 40 enumerated numbering conventions (row/column-major, snake, spiral, all 8 orientations) slot 4 is never a corner - only 1, 3, 7 and 9 can be. The one convention that would vindicate 4 is an anti-diagonal scan. UNRESOLVED - see open_questions. Positioning does NOT depend on this: the origin comes from the measured corners.

placements.name: water
placements.near_slot_note: Operator thinks position 9, stated with low confidence. Recorded as a REFERENCE only. The dip point X 0 is exactly the envelope minimum, i.e. a trough at the deck edge rather than a plate centre; it does sit inside slot 9's cell, 2.75 mm from its low-X edge.

open_questions: Is the tip rack in stage location 3 or 4? Its measured grid centre is 3.0 mm from slot 3 and 284 mm from slot 4. Jog to X 65 Y 365 Z 5 and read the label at the position the rack actually occupies - that settles both this and the x'=420+x frame in one move.

Is the x'=420+x slot frame right at all? parameters.json's 9 centres have NEVER been executed: stagetourjson.gcode emits them verbatim as X-84/X-220/X-355 plus Z-20, and all 9 are outside the 0-420 X envelope, so Klipper would have rejected the first move. Jog to the centre of any EMPTY labelled position and record X: ~200 or ~336 confirms x'=420+x.

Is the 0.65 mL tube holder seated in a stage position, or on its own bracket? If it is a custom fixture then 'position 8' is a colloquial pointer and its 68 mm offset from the slot centre stops being a discrepancy.
Which tiprack corner is A1 - the three corners fix the grid but not the labelling.
Which X edge of the tiprack is the post-pickup exit (toward X 18 or toward X 118).
z_stage_surface has never been measured, so tip-aware absolute Z limits cannot be checked.
